text:
maria: quick sync — qbench on q6b-int4 showed a duplication pattern in the promptset used for golden. looks like quantization + tokenizer normalisation collapsed paraphrases. tagging @labeling-team :eyes:
jon: paste an example? exact or semantic dup?
maria: example — two samples collapsed after int4 kernels. original: "Order status for order #12345" and paraphrase: "Where is my order 12345?". token remap made identical fingerprint.
alex: our dedupe uses fingerprint_v3 tied to tokenizer_v2. if quant runtime changed token boundaries we must re-run fingerprinting.
maria: cost/time? we have ~400k prompts.
tara: rough: ~6 hrs on current shard workers, ~1.5 hrs if parallelized x4. cost ~ $50 spot.
sam: we also need golden annotation review for affected anchors — some golden labels are model-specific. ops-bot can export list?
ops-bot: queued: `export_promptset --name promptbank-v3 --filter "fp_conflict=true" --out s3://redwood-temp/q6b-fp-conflicts.json` (job 2449)
jon: maria — add a reproducible snippet + PR with re-fingerprint script and dry-run mode.
maria: will do. plan: targeted re-fingerprint on flagged anchors, then full run after verifying no regressions.
tara: labelers heads-up: re-fingerprinting may reshuffle duplicates and requeue samples; contractor queues could spike.
sam: contractor lead notified — will prep extra reviewers and stricter golden-change checks.
alex: checklist: (1) default read-only, (2) golden changes need 2 approvers, (3) record diff + provenance tag.
maria: i'll draft checklist and post in #help Fri. adding one-off eval: `python eval/regression_check.py --model q6b-int4 --gold s3://...`
jon: can we avoid full run by making fingerprint tolerant to token shifts? char-level rolling hash (w=7) fallback maybe.
tara: reduces conflicts but risks false merges. A/B test on 10k slice.
sam: contractor ops — schedule reviewers for A/B slice and rescue window.
ops-bot: invite created: "q6b-int4 promptbank rescue" tomorrow 10:00-13:00 PT.
maria: opening PR with scripts + sampleset, expected EOD. :thumbsup:
jon: will run A/B and share metrics (dup rate, label churn, eval delta).
ara: joining late — verify other quant profiles (int8/fp16) too?
maria: initial diffs point to int4 tokenizer mapping in runtime v1.3.0. will sweep int8/fp16 quickly.
jon: next steps recap: maria PR + A/B (10k), tara coordinate labeler capacity, sam manage approvals, alex draft two-approver process, ops-bot export conflict list. Triage by EOD tomorrow.
maria: updating this thread with PR & results.
jon: thanks all. :sparkles:
